# KejaApp

> KejaApp helps tenants, landlords, agencies, and movers find and manage
> rental housing in Kenya - discover verified rentals, message about
> viewings, manage listings, and arrange moving services from one
> workspace.

KejaApp is a rental-housing marketplace, not a general real-estate
listings aggregator: every account has one role (tenant, landlord,
agency, or mover), and most of the app is workspace-style tooling for
signed-in users rather than public content. The pages below are the
only ones meant for general browsing or citation.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://kejaapp-backend-7iu3.onrender.com/): landing page and property discovery entry point
- [Search](https://kejaapp-backend-7iu3.onrender.com/search): browse listings without an account
- [Movers](https://kejaapp-backend-7iu3.onrender.com/movers): find moving-service providers
- [Privacy Policy](https://kejaapp-backend-7iu3.onrender.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://kejaapp-backend-7iu3.onrender.com/terms)
- [Data Protection](https://kejaapp-backend-7iu3.onrender.com/data-protection)
